query:
SELECT
                h.id AS highlight_id,
                h.text_content AS text,
                hn.body AS "note?",
                CASE
                    WHEN h.locator ->> 'type' = 'epub' THEN h.locator ->> 'chapter'
                    ELSE NULL
                END AS "section_key?"
            FROM highlights h
            LEFT JOIN highlight_notes hn ON hn.highlight_id = h.id
            WHERE h.document_id = $1
            ORDER BY h.created_at ASC
